name: Sandboxie
description: Inspect Sandboxie processes and bounded memory headlessly, gate each agent write on window approval, and keep launch, capture and trace overrides in the page.

tools.name: sandboxie_probe
tools.description: Read bridge/version availability and enabled boxes on this device. Returns exact bridge JSON text. Does not start or stop trace monitoring.

tools.name: sandboxie_processes
tools.description: List live accessible processes in one enabled box on this device. Returns exact bridge JSON text including lowercase creation tokens; missing processes are not evidence of absence.

tools.name: sandboxie_regions
tools.description: Read one bounded memory-map page for the exact box/PID/creation token. Returns exact bridge JSON text; use its hexadecimal next cursor for another explicit call. No memory scan or monitor starts.

created.description: Copy the exact nonzero lowercase creation token from sandboxie_processes; do not convert it to a number.

start.description: Exact hexadecimal cursor, never a floating-point number.

tools.name: sandboxie_read_memory
tools.description: Read 1 to 4096 sensitive bytes from the exact box/PID/creation token and hexadecimal address. Returns exact bridge JSON text, including partial-read errors. One bounded chunk only; no automatic retry or scan.

created.description: Exact nonzero lowercase creation token from sandboxie_processes.

address.description: Exact 0x-prefixed address; never convert a 64-bit value to a number.

tools.name: sandboxie_prepare_write
tools.description: Prepare exactly one immutable 1 to 256 byte write for fresh human review in the Sandboxie page. Requires the originating chat. Never writes memory. Both strict unprefixed hex strings must encode the same length; approval expires after about three minutes.

created.description: Exact nonzero lowercase creation token from sandboxie_processes.

expected_hex.description: Exact bytes expected immediately before writing, with no 0x prefix, whitespace or separators. Same byte length as data_hex.

data_hex.description: Exact replacement bytes. Same byte length as expected_hex. The compare and write are not atomic.

tools.name: sandboxie_apply_write
tools.description: Consume this chat's approved, unexpired write ID before one bridge attempt. Takes only the ID: approved bytes/target cannot change. Never retries or rolls back. Timeout or response loss may mean an unknown outcome; use sandboxie_write_status, not another apply.

id.description: Opaque ID from sandboxie_prepare_write in this same chat.

tools.name: sandboxie_write_status
tools.description: Read the bounded ephemeral state/result for this chat's exact write ID without attempting a write. At most eight terminal results remain for five minutes; a service stop/restart/update forgets everything. Missing status never proves a lost write did not occur.

tools.name: sandboxie_capture_data
tools.description: Read UTF-8 byte chunks of the exact original JSON from a retained human-initiated capture for this box in an open Sandboxie window. Never starts/stops monitoring or obtains fresh data; requires an open window and a completed human UI capture. Follow the returned next offset.

box.description: Must match the box of the capture retained by the open window.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset into the exact original capture JSON, not an event index. Use the returned next offset.

limit.description: Maximum bytes in this response chunk; the window preserves UTF-8 boundaries.
